claim: Let \(k\) be any field of characteristic \(p>0\), let \(m\ge2\), and set \(A_m=k[t]/(t^m)\). The automorphism group scheme of \(A_m\) is smooth over \(k\) if and only if \(p\nmid m\). If \(m=q=p^e\) for \(e\ge1\), its full representing scheme is \(\operatorname{Spec} k[c_0,c_1,c_1^{-1},c_2,\ldots,c_{q-1}]/(c_0^q)\).
scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The result is limited to one-variable truncated polynomial algebras \(k[t]/(t^m)\) over fields of positive characteristic.
The prime-power case gives the representing scheme as a scheme; no product decomposition of its group law is claimed.
Novelty is assessed by bounded literature comparison, not asserted universally; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Smoothness threshold for automorphism schemes of truncated polynomial algebras
